title: Arrow reports the child interval and hash of a relocated list view
summary: The nonzero-offset view changed from an empty reported child interval to [3,5). Relocating its two children now preserves the slot hash on both allocator backends.

change.description: Arrow’s list-view end index becomes the exclusive child index.

notes: Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
